An orchestration-layer skill for the full academic paper lifecycle. It encodes human-AI collaboration and anti-hallucination gates into a nine-stage pipeline (S0-S8) covering topic scoping, literature retrieval, review synthesis, outlining, drafting, figures, revision, simulated review and compliance, and routes concrete work to existing specialist skills. Core principle — AI is your copilot, not the pilot. Every revision returns a diff for the author to accept or reject; nothing is silently overwritten.
